rec.name: Product Short Videos (Story-Style Video Thumbnails)
rec.status: Superseded — marked obsolete by the "Multiple Product Videos" element (Apr 2025); keep as reference only

what.text: A PDP block titled "Product Short Videos" showing a row of small circular video thumbnails, similar to social media stories. The first thumbnail has a colored gradient ring (orange to purple) marking it as the active or unwatched item. The others have no ring. The thumbnails show short product-in-use clips, such as hands handling a bag, a close-up detail, and a person carrying the product. It can sit inside the buy box or be a larger standalone section. Reference: the Shopify theme "YUVA" and the PL team's example on sperling-bags.com (2-in-1 Rucksacktasche Triple).

why.text: Short clips show size, material, and real-life use faster than static photos, which reduces uncertainty before purchase. The story-style circles are familiar from Instagram and TikTok, so they invite a tap. The gradient ring on the first item signals unseen content and creates curiosity. Videos of people using the product also work as lightweight social proof.

how.text: Build it as a PDP block or section that renders a horizontal row of circular thumbnails, one per product video. Source the videos from product-level metafields or media. Tapping a thumbnail presumably opens the clip in a modal or story-style player (not shown in the ticket). Give the first or active item a gradient ring. Offer two placements: compact inside the buy box, or a larger standalone section. Make the icon size a theme setting (for example a CSS variable driven by a range slider).

items: Placement: inside the buy box or as a standalone section
Gradient ring on the active/first item (on/off, colors)
Videos per product (via metafield or product media)

dependencies.text: Needs short video assets per product, probably stored as product metafields or product media (inferred). Needs a modal or story-style video player (not specified). The YUVA theme is the visual reference. The ticket says this is superseded by the "Multiple Product Videos" element, so check that element before building.

items: Video play rate and average watch time
PDP add-to-cart rate for sessions with a video play vs. without
Conversion rate and revenue per visitor

images.caption: Row of three circular video thumbnails under the heading "Product Short Videos"; the first has a gradient ring.
